title: Inside the Reform — what Verne got right
learning_goal: Know the Reform Club is real, founded 1836, Barry's palazzo of 1841, Soyer's kitchens, and Fogg's breakfast; feel cosy club warmth.

narration.script: We arrive at the door of Fogg's club. The Reform Club is real, and still here: 104 Pall Mall, since 1836. Its founders backed the great Reform Act of 1832 — hence the name. In the novel this is Fogg's whole world: he eats here, reads here, plays cards here, every day until midnight. Charles Barry's palazzo opened in 1841: Portland stone outside; inside, a saloon two storeys high under a glass roof. And the famous kitchens that the chef Alexis Soyer helped to plan. Look down — they ran in the basement, under all this. Now Fogg's breakfast, taken here. A broiled fish with Reading sauce — keep that in mind. Roast beef, a tart, Cheshire cheese, and the tea the Reform is famous for. Inside today: a tessellated floor, marble busts, portraits between the columns. Barry's elevation of the front. Somewhere in there, breakfast done, Fogg cuts the pages himself and reads The Times.

variants.clear: This is the door of Fogg's club: the Reform Club. It is real, and still here — 104 Pall Mall, since 1836. Its founders had backed the Reform Act of 1832 — that is where the name comes from. In the book, Fogg spends every day here until midnight: meals, newspapers, cards. The architect Charles Barry finished the building in 1841. Stone outside; inside, a grand hall two floors high, under a glass roof. The club also had famous kitchens, planned with the chef Alexis Soyer. They were down in the basement. Here Fogg ate his breakfast: grilled fish with Reading sauce — remember that sauce. Roast beef, a fruit tart, cheese, and the club's famous tea. Then Barry's own drawing of the front. Somewhere in there, Fogg cuts his newspaper's pages and reads The Times.

production_notes: A9 2026-08-27 (content-preparer) — THE SCENE NOW GOES INSIDE. Free interior material does exist; the earlier 'no PD Reform interior beyond one 1841 engraving' finding was wrong (media/manifest.md §A9). Four of the seven pictures are interiors: M-96 (Fagan 1887, the saloon from the SW corner), M-95 (Soyer's kitchens, 1842), M-94 (a 2013 photograph inside), M-23 (1841). TYPE CHANGED video -> photo. This is the load-bearing change: in the player, a 'video' scene with a youtube item calls showYouTube() and NEVER shows the scene's images (index.html, showScene) — which is exactly why the founder saw 70 s of outdoor walking under an 'Inside' title. As a photo scene the player cycles the images every max(8000, duration_s*1000/n) ms = 10 s for seven, in ARRAY ORDER, ignoring start_s; start_s/end_s are set to the same 10-s slots so the rendered cut matches what the player shows. Adding or removing one image re-times the whole scene — keep it at seven. M-01 (Wanderizm, Standard YouTube Licence, embed-only) was REMOVED from this scene: it is inert in a photo scene, and the arrival at the Reform door is scene 04's job (D6). To restore it, re-add {kind:'youtube', ref:'WQCsxb2dMgQ', start_s:1610, end_s:1655, use:'player'} and set type back to 'video' — but then the interiors disappear again. SLOTS, ten seconds each (checked against the player's own words-per-second estimate, 2.6 x rate, on BOTH tracks — clear English is the default, at rate 0.9): 0-10 M-20 the front today (arrival, the address) · 10-20 M-97 the ground plan (‘his whole world: he eats here, reads here, plays cards here’) · 20-30 M-96 THE SALOON (spoken 20.8-28.1 literary / 22.2-31.6 clear) · 30-40 M-95 SOYER'S KITCHENS (28.1-36.9 / 31.6-39.3) · 40-50 M-94 INSIDE TODAY (the breakfast, 36.9-48.5 / 39.3-50.0) · 50-60 M-22 Barry's elevation (52.7-54.6 / 50.0-53.0) · 60-70 M-23 1841, the closing image. The one residual drift: the literary line ‘Inside today: a tessellated floor…’ starts at 48.5 s, 1.5 s before M-94 leaves the screen. RESOLUTION: M-94 (729 px), M-22 (709 px) and M-23 (632 px) are under the player's 760-px plate threshold and mount as small paper plates with their credit under them; M-95, M-96, M-97, M-20 are 1200-4000 px and are contained or filled. Nothing is upscaled anywhere — pickTreatment() caps the fit at 1.0. NARRATION CHANGED (Narrator to sign off, see review.notes): 'no camera has been inside for us' is now false and is gone from both tracks; the closing picture-by-picture enumeration is gone because seven equally-spaced images cannot keep a three-item promise spoken in five seconds; the 'look up at the first-floor windows' cue (written for a façade video) became 'Look down — they ran in the basement' so it lands on the kitchen plate (F-47); one new sentence describes the 2013 photograph while it is on screen. Earlier notes that still hold: no paper-knife (F-06); the coffee-room's nine windows are in the SOUTH garden wall, so 'nine' stays out of this scene (Quiz A follows, F-15); the linear cut opens on M-20 and scene 04 ends on the open-imagery arrival at the door, so the two do not repeat the same shot.

A3n narrator+scene-developer 2026-08-19 (newcomer rewrite): opener now says whose club this is and what it is to Fogg (a first-time reader meets 'the Reform' cold otherwise); Reform Act line recast as the name's plain explanation; clear-English variant added; 'nine' still kept out (Quiz A follows). A5 narrator 2026-08-19 (fact-check-a5 §1): clear track 'Its founders wanted political reform; that is the name' → 'Its founders had backed the Reform Act of 1832 — that is where the name comes from' (F-14: 1836, by Radicals and Whigs who had backed the 1832 Act — as simplified it sounded like a campaign for a reform already law); 'the architect's drawing' → 'the architect's plan of the front' (M-22 is an engraving of Barry's north elevation, not his hand). Linear cut now opens on s:0 ('This is the door of Fogg's club') and keeps s:2, so the video no longer starts on a dangling 'It is real, and still here…' and does explain the club's name; the Soyer kitchens and the closing Times line pay for the seconds, and the three insets are timed 38 / 9 / rest so 'the front today' is said over the front. NARRATOR, PLEASE SIGN OFF ON FOUR SCRIPT EDITS: (1) '— no camera has been inside for us' deleted from both tracks (we now show a photograph from inside, and Fagan 1887 prints a photogravure of the library, M-100); (2) 'The front today; Barry's elevation.
